---
title: "Fig. 4F - Shrb RNAi EdU-positive follicle cells"
output: null
date: "2026-03-05"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggprism)
library(ggpubr)
source("analysis_helpers.R")
```

```{r}
# Fig. 4F: calculate EdU-positive follicle cell percentage for each germarium.

data_file <- "../Data/Fig4F_shrbRNAi_EdU_positive_cells.csv"
output_file <- "../Results/Fig4F_shrbRNAi_EdU_positive_cells.pdf"

shrb_rnai_edupositivecells_totalcells <- read_analysis_csv(data_file) %>%
  mutate(Edu_Positive_Percent = 100 * EduPositiveCells / TotalCells)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 4F: average EdU-positive percentages within each replicate for testing.
# Individual germaria are shown as points in the plot.

shrb_rnai_edupositivecells_totalcells_summary <- shrb_rnai_edupositivecells_totalcells %>%
  group_by(Genotype, Group, Replicate) %>%
  summarise(
    Edu_Positive_Percent = mean(Edu_Positive_Percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# Fig. 4F: compare replicate means between control and shrb RNAi.

stat_results <- shrb_rnai_edupositivecells_totalcells_summary %>%
  group_by(Genotype) %>%
  rstatix::t_test(Edu_Positive_Percent ~ Group) %>%
  rstatix::add_significance("p") %>%
  rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "Group", step.increase = 1, dodge = 0.8)
print(stat_results)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 4F: plot EdU-positive follicle cell percentages.

plot_box_jitter(
  data = shrb_rnai_edupositivecells_totalcells,
  summary_data = shrb_rnai_edupositivecells_totalcells_summary,
  x = Group,
  y = Edu_Positive_Percent,
  plot_title = "% of Edu+ follicle cells",
  y_limits = c(0, 50),
  y_labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1),
  p_values = stat_results,
  bracket_size = 0.3,
  p_value_size = 2.5
)
```
```{r}
ggsave(output_file, width = 2, height = 2.5, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 4F: manuscript summary values for replicate means.

summarize_mean_sd(
  shrb_rnai_edupositivecells_totalcells_summary,
  group_cols = "Group",
  value_col = Edu_Positive_Percent
)
```
